rows.scope: Per-kind outcome of uninstall (and -purge): CLS, PKG, INC, MAC/INT/OBJ, record, manifest stream and sync baseline removed; name-only GBL data kept (P:F-UNIN-5), Global-attribute GBL deleted; FileCopy removed unless KeepOnUninstall. Native x1, x3. Table data/purge is owned by uninstall.purge.as-built and not re-tested.

Declared <Mapping> GBL and PKG entries added at Reload remain after uninstall and -purge; developer-mode ^Sources("MODULE",name) and ^Sources("cls",pkg) entries remain after uninstall. Native i1/x1/x3, i2/x2. No uninstall caller of RemoveGlobalMapping/RemovePackageMapping or ^Sources kill (source search).
